title: Sortable list component with keyboard, pointer and touch reorder
goal: A list the user can reorder without a mouse, that emits the new order
acceptance: bx-sortable-list: items from the consumer (id, label, optional secondary text), pointer and touch drag with a visible drop position, and a keyboard path (move up/down buttons on each item; Space to grab, arrows to move, Space to drop, Escape to cancel)
Each move is announced in a polite live region; the component emits orderChange (the ids in the new order) and never persists anything
Unit tests for the reorder logic; browser test: keyboard reorder, drag reorder, axe-clean in every theme, light and dark, reduced motion
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no personal data, tokens or private reports in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Keyboard and live-region work is most of it; no library (Angular CDK drag-drop is an option T01 may weigh against plain pointer events). Estimated 2026-11-26. Not a measurement.
